articles.summary: UCLA researchers have discovered two powerful influences that help guide how the human brain forms before birth. Those signals can alter which types of neurons are produced, including upper-layer neurons that are especially prominent in humans.

articles.title: 80,000-year-old “arrowheads” rewrite human history
articles.summary: Archaeologists have identified tiny 80,000-year-old projectile points in Uzbekistan that may have been used like arrowheads.
